text:
Ivy: Heads-up - HelioMetrics has three declines on INV-5601 this morning. Gateway shows 3DS_REQUIRED and AVS_MISMATCH on two cards. ACH microdeposit succeeded but customer says remittance not recognized. Can payments ops triage?
Max: Which charge ids and last4?
Ivy: ch_07UVWX..., ch_07UVWY...; last4 1234 (Visa) and 6789 (MC). Gateway notes: 3DS_REQUIRED on first, AVS_MISMATCH on second. ACH verify returned microdeposit_trace mdep_44 but finance didn't match payer name.
Kasia: Finance: we can accept wire or virtual card. We'll waive one late fee if customer provides remittance within 72h. For ACH, we need purchaser name + payment trace to reconcile.
Renee: Pausing retries for this merchant_id to avoid more 3DS hits. I'll set autopay=false and add a stop-retry rule for 3DS_REQUIRED and AVS_MISMATCH.
PaymentsBot: autopay flag updated for heliometrics - retries suspended.
Max: I'll send the virtual card option and wire template to the customer. Also recommend we mark invoice with hold_reason='3DS_AVS' so billing workers skip it.
Ivy: Please include exact remittance format we need.
Kasia: Internal wire template: Bank: Capital One; Account: Redwood Inference, Inc.; Acct: 1122334455; ABA: 051000017; SWIFT: HIBKUS44; Reference: HelioMetrics-INV-5601. For ACH/paid via bank, include payer legal name and invoice number.
Renee: Billing config patched to add '3DS_REQUIRED' to non-retryable errors for 30 days on this merchant. Deployed.
Max: Zendesk ticket Z#12200 created and customer notified. Message: "We can accept virtual card or wire. If you send wire, reply with remittance screenshot and payer name and we'll mark invoice settled immediately."
ZendeskBot: Ticket Z#12200 created for HelioMetrics payment failure.
Ivy: Customer replied that their AP team is doing the wire now and will DM remittance.
Kasia: Finance ops: when remittance arrives, confirm bank trace and set invoice.status='settled-wire', cancel any scheduled retries, and attach proof to ticket. We'll apply the waiver.
Max: Quick commands I used to pull logs: `curl -s "https://payments.redwood/internal/charges?invoice=INV-5601" | jq .`
PaymentsBot: Alert: escalate if >4 failed attempts in 12h for heliometrics.
Renee: Follow-ups: add 3DS and AVS test cases to pay-harness, review our 3DS redirect UX for retry flows, and ask gateway for AVS details if remittance doesn't clear.
Ivy: Closing loop - Max to update Zendesk with remittance when it arrives, Kasia to reconcile, Renee to post any gateway findings. Thanks :thumbsup:
